READ: HOW TO CHOOSE THE RIGHT RUNNING SHOES / SPORTS BRA BUYING GUIDE

Your run deserves kit that works as hard as you do. This is the home of women's running clothing and shoes, a collection engineered to deliver performance, comfort, and confidence on every single stride. We understand that the right gear is more than just functional—it’s about finding a fit that feels made for you, empowering you to push your limits or simply enjoy the moment.

The foundation of any great run is the right pair of running shoes for women. Recognising that the female foot has a unique shape, our collection features trainers built on women's-specific designs for a superior fit and feel. Whether you need the balanced, everyday comfort of a neutral shoe like the ASICS GEL-Nimbus, the gentle guidance of a stability shoe like the Saucony Guide, or the rugged grip of a dedicated trail shoe, you'll find the perfect partner for your gait and your goals.

Beyond your feet, the right apparel transforms your run. Our range of women's running clothing is built from advanced technical fabrics that wick sweat away, keeping you dry and focused. Discover supportive, high-impact sports bras, breathable tops, and running leggings with a second-skin feel that won't slip or chafe. For runs that don’t stop for the weather, our lightweight and protective running jackets provide a vital shield against wind and rain

Start by considering your foot type, running gait, and the surfaces you run on. Popular models like the Brooks Ghost offer cushioning for neutral runners, while trail shoes provide grip and stability for off-road routes. Gait analysis at Runners Need can help you find your ideal fit for comfort and injury prevention.

Look for breathable, moisture-wicking fabrics to keep you cool and dry, such as those found in leggings, tights, tank tops, and sports bras. Flat seams reduce chafing, while reflective details on tops and jackets improve safety in low light. Choose layers that suit the weather, from lightweight tees to waterproof jackets.

Yes, trail running shoes have deeper lugs and reinforced soles for grip and protection on uneven terrain, while road shoes focus on cushioning and responsiveness for hard surfaces. Waterproof options are available for wet conditions, and racing flats are ideal for speed on smooth courses.

Key accessories include hats or caps for sun protection, sunglasses, water bottles or hydration packs for staying hydrated, and running belts or phone armbands for carrying essentials. Reflective gear and running lights boost safety, while GPS watches help track your progress and set goals.

Running clothing should offer a snug but non-restrictive fit, allowing freedom of movement. High-rise waistbands on leggings prevent slipping, and adjustable straps on sports bras ensure proper support. Try on different sizes and styles to find what feels most comfortable for your body and running style.
